## Purpose
Card showing the owner's Goodreads books, currently-reading first and then read. It fetches both shelves' RSS feeds client-side, parses the XML, and renders cover, title, author and a status badge. It renders nothing unless `books.display` is true.

## Key concepts
- `Book` (title, author, optional coverUrl and link, status `reading | read`) and `BooksCardProps` (`loading`, `books: SanitizedBooks`).
- `fetchBooks`: requests `currently-reading` and `read` shelves in parallel with `Promise.allSettled`, so one failing shelf does not hide the other.
- `parseRSSFeed`: uses `DOMParser`, reads `author_name`, `book_id`, `link`, and extracts the cover from the first `<img>` in the item description.
- Display count is `books.limit` (default 5); config comes from `SanitizedBooks` in [[src-interfaces]]; skeletons via [[src-utils]]. The server proxy in [[pages-api]] is a related but unused alternative.

## Gotchas
- Feeds are fetched through the third-party `https://api.allorigins.win/get` CORS proxy and the XML is read from `data.contents`; if that service is down the card shows an error.
- The limit is applied after merging, so many 'reading' books can crowd out 'read' ones.
- Uses a plain `<img>` for covers rather than [[src-components-lazy-image]].
